items.question: Trong câu "You need to combine several representations — textual and visual, at different levels of abstraction — to paint a full picture of the intended system.", từ "abstraction" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "You need to combine several representations — textual and visual, at different levels of abstraction — to paint a full picture of the intended system.", what does "abstraction" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a general view that hides detail
items.explanation: abstraction /æbˈstræk.ʃən/ (danh từ): sự trừu tượng hoá. "Levels of abstraction" = các mức trừu tượng, từ tổng quan (ít chi tiết) đến cụ thể (nhiều chi tiết).
items.explanationEn: abstraction /æbˈstræk.ʃən/ (noun): a general view that hides detail. "Levels of abstraction" range from a high-level overview to a detailed view.

items.question: Trong câu "Comparing representations created through different thought processes and notations reveals inconsistencies, ambiguities, assumptions, and omissions that no single view exposes.", từ "omission" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Comparing representations created through different thought processes and notations reveals inconsistencies, ambiguities, assumptions, and omissions that no single view exposes.", what does "omission" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: omission /əˈmɪʃ.ən/ (danh từ): sự bỏ sót. Động từ gốc là "omit" (bỏ sót, lược bỏ); "errors and omissions" = sai sót và thiếu sót.
items.explanationEn: omission /əˈmɪʃ.ən/ (noun): something left out. The verb is "omit"; the collocation "errors and omissions" is common in reviews and contracts.

items.question: Trong câu "Comparing representations created through different thought processes and notations reveals inconsistencies, ambiguities, assumptions, and omissions that no single view exposes.", từ "inconsistency" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Comparing representations created through different thought processes and notations reveals inconsistencies, ambiguities, assumptions, and omissions that no single view exposes.", what does "inconsistency" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a lack of agreement between parts
items.explanation: inconsistency /ˌɪn.kənˈsɪs.tən.si/ (danh từ): sự không nhất quán. Hay gặp trong review tài liệu: "find inconsistencies between the model and the text" (tìm chỗ mâu thuẫn).
items.explanationEn: inconsistency /ˌɪn.kənˈsɪs.tən.si/ (noun): a lack of agreement between parts. Common in reviews: "find inconsistencies between the model and the text".

items.question: Trong câu "They also help bridge language and vocabulary barriers among team members.", từ "bridge" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "They also help bridge language and vocabulary barriers among team members.", what does "bridge" (verb) mean?
options: xây cây cầu bắc qua sông
optionsEn: to build a structure over a river
to overcome a gap or division
to put up a dividing barrier
to widen a gap or division
items.explanation: bridge /brɪdʒ/ (động từ): vượt qua, thu hẹp (khoảng cách). Cụm thường gặp: "bridge the gap between business and IT" (thu hẹp khoảng cách giữa nghiệp vụ và kỹ thuật).
items.explanationEn: bridge /brɪdʒ/ (verb): to overcome a gap or division. A common collocation is "bridge the gap between business and IT".

items.question: Trong câu "However, experience shows that analysis models should SUPPLEMENT rather than replace a natural-language specification.", từ "supplement" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "However, experience shows that analysis models should SUPPLEMENT rather than replace a natural-language specification.", what does "supplement" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: supplement /ˈsʌp.lɪ.ment/ (động từ): bổ sung. "Supplement rather than replace" = bổ sung chứ không thay thế; danh từ "supplement" còn có nghĩa thực phẩm bổ sung.
items.explanationEn: supplement /ˈsʌp.lɪ.ment/ (verb): to add to something. "Supplement rather than replace" means adding to, not taking over; as a noun it also means an extra part or a dietary supplement.

items.question: Trong câu "Do not look for a single diagram that encompasses everything.", từ "encompass" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Do not look for a single diagram that encompasses everything.", what does "encompass" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: encompass /ɪnˈkʌm.pəs/ (động từ): bao gồm, bao quát. Văn phong trang trọng hơn "include": "a plan that encompasses all teams".
items.explanationEn: encompass /ɪnˈkʌm.pəs/ (verb): to include fully. A more formal word than "include": "a plan that encompasses all teams".

items.question: Trong câu "Visual models help you spot missing, superfluous, and inconsistent requirements.", từ "superfluous" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Visual models help you spot missing, superfluous, and inconsistent requirements.", what does "superfluous" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: superfluous /suːˈpɜː.flu.əs/ (tính từ): thừa, không cần thiết. "Superfluous requirements" = yêu cầu thừa, không mang lại giá trị và nên loại bỏ.
items.explanationEn: superfluous /suːˈpɜː.flu.əs/ (adjective): more than is needed. "Superfluous requirements" add no value and should be removed.

items.question: Trong câu "They make it easy to refine diagrams over several iterations — you will almost never draw it right the first time, so the ability to iterate is key to success.", từ "refine" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "They make it easy to refine diagrams over several iterations — you will almost never draw it right the first time, so the ability to iterate is key to success.", what does "refine" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: refine /rɪˈfaɪn/ (động từ): tinh chỉnh, làm rõ dần. Trong phân tích yêu cầu, "refine" là làm chi tiết và chính xác hơn qua nhiều vòng; "progressive refinement" = tinh chỉnh dần.
items.explanationEn: refine /rɪˈfaɪn/ (verb): to improve by small changes. In requirements work, "refine" means making something more detailed and precise over iterations; see "progressive refinement".

items.question: Trong câu "They enforce the rules of each modeling method, catching syntax errors and inconsistencies a reviewer might miss.", từ "enforce" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "They enforce the rules of each modeling method, catching syntax errors and inconsistencies a reviewer might miss.", what does "enforce" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: enforce /ɪnˈfɔːs/ (động từ): bắt buộc tuân thủ. Hay đi với "rules", "policies", "constraints": "the database enforces referential integrity".
items.explanationEn: enforce /ɪnˈfɔːs/ (verb): to make people follow. Often used with rules, policies or constraints: "the database enforces referential integrity".

items.question: Trong câu "The extra time is more than repaid by catching requirements errors before you build the system.", từ "repay" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The extra time is more than repaid by catching requirements errors before you build the system.", what does "repay" (verb) mean?
options: bù đắp, đền đáp xứng đáng
optionsEn: to give back value for effort
items.explanation: repay /rɪˈpeɪ/ (động từ): bù đắp, đền đáp xứng đáng. "More than repaid" = thu lại nhiều hơn công bỏ ra; nghĩa đen là trả lại tiền vay.
items.explanationEn: repay /rɪˈpeɪ/ (verb): to give back value for effort. "More than repaid" means the benefit exceeds the cost; literally it means paying back a loan.

items.question: Trong câu "Models or portions of models can sometimes be reused from one project to another, or at least serve as a straw-man starting point for the next one.", từ "straw man" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Models or portions of models can sometimes be reused from one project to another, or at least serve as a straw-man starting point for the next one.", what does "straw man" (noun) mean?
options: bản nháp sơ bộ để góp ý
optionsEn: a distorted version of an argument
a rough first draft for discussion
items.explanation: straw man /ˌstrɔː ˈmæn/ (danh từ): bản nháp sơ bộ để góp ý. Trong công việc, "straw man" là bản nháp đưa ra để mọi người phản biện; trong tranh luận nó còn chỉ lỗi ngụy biện bóp méo lập luận.
items.explanationEn: straw man /ˌstrɔː ˈmæn/ (noun): a rough first draft for discussion. In business, a straw man is a draft proposal meant to be critiqued; in debate it also names the fallacy of misrepresenting an argument.

items.question: Trong câu "The parts most susceptible to ambiguity or remaining uncertainty.", từ "susceptible" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The parts most susceptible to ambiguity or remaining uncertainty.", what does "susceptible" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: susceptible /səˈsep.tə.bəl/ (tính từ): dễ bị ảnh hưởng. Cấu trúc "susceptible to + danh từ": "susceptible to errors", "susceptible to attack".
items.explanationEn: susceptible /səˈsep.tə.bəl/ (adjective): easily affected by. Used as "susceptible to + noun": "susceptible to errors", "susceptible to attack".

items.question: Trong câu "From this short paragraph the BA can extract the actors", từ "extract" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "From this short paragraph the BA can extract the actors", what does "extract" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: extract /ɪkˈstrækt/ (động từ): rút ra, trích xuất. Trong phân tích: "extract requirements from interview notes" (rút yêu cầu từ ghi chú phỏng vấn).
items.explanationEn: extract /ɪkˈstrækt/ (verb): to take out or identify. In analysis: "extract requirements from interview notes".

items.question: Trong câu "Do not assume that customers already know how to read analysis models — but also do not conclude that they cannot understand them.", từ "conclude" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Do not assume that customers already know how to read analysis models — but also do not conclude that they cannot understand them.", what does "conclude" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to bring a meeting to an end
items.explanation: conclude /kənˈkluːd/ (động từ): kết luận, suy ra. "Conclude that + mệnh đề" = đi đến kết luận rằng; "conclude a meeting" lại là kết thúc cuộc họp.
items.explanationEn: conclude /kənˈkluːd/ (verb): to decide from evidence. "Conclude that + clause" means to reach a judgment; "conclude a meeting" means to end it.

items.question: Trong câu "walk through a sample model to help them learn how to review each kind of diagram.", từ "walk through" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "walk through a sample model to help them learn how to review each kind of diagram.", what does "walk through" (phrase) mean?
options: hướng dẫn xem qua từng bước
items.explanation: walk through /wɔːk θruː/ (cụm từ): hướng dẫn xem qua từng bước. Danh từ "walkthrough" = buổi rà soát từng bước (tài liệu, mã nguồn, mô hình).
items.explanationEn: walk through /wɔːk θruː/ (phrase): to explain step by step. The noun "walkthrough" is a step-by-step review of a document, code or model.

items.question: Trong câu "The data flow diagram (DFD) is a cornerstone of structured analysis.", từ "cornerstone" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The data flow diagram (DFD) is a cornerstone of structured analysis.", what does "cornerstone" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a stone at a building corner
items.explanation: cornerstone /ˈkɔː.nə.stəʊn/ (danh từ): nền tảng, trụ cột. Nghĩa bóng phổ biến: "a cornerstone of the method" = thành phần cốt lõi.
items.explanationEn: cornerstone /ˈkɔː.nə.stəʊn/ (noun): a basic, essential part. Mostly figurative: "a cornerstone of the method" is its most essential part.

items.question: Trong câu "The collections (stores) of data or material the system manipulates — drawn as two parallel horizontal lines.", từ "manipulate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The collections (stores) of data or material the system manipulates — drawn as two parallel horizontal lines.", what does "manipulate" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to keep for a long time
items.explanation: manipulate /məˈnɪp.jə.leɪt/ (động từ): xử lý, thao tác (dữ liệu). Với dữ liệu, "manipulate" mang nghĩa trung tính là xử lý; với con người thì mang nghĩa xấu là thao túng.
items.explanationEn: manipulate /məˈnɪp.jə.leɪt/ (verb): to process or change data. With data it is neutral (process, change); with people it is negative (control unfairly).

items.question: Trong câu "DFDs use a functional decomposition approach, subdividing a complex problem into progressive levels of detail.", từ "decomposition" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "DFDs use a functional decomposition approach, subdividing a complex problem into progressive levels of detail.", what does "decomposition" (noun) mean?
options: sự phân rã thành phần nhỏ
items.explanation: decomposition /ˌdiː.kɒm.pəˈzɪʃ.ən/ (danh từ): sự phân rã thành phần nhỏ. "Functional decomposition" = chia một chức năng lớn thành các chức năng con.
items.explanationEn: decomposition /ˌdiː.kɒm.pəˈzɪʃ.ən/ (noun): breaking into smaller parts. "Functional decomposition" splits a large function into smaller sub-functions.

items.question: Trong câu "DFDs use a functional decomposition approach, subdividing a complex problem into progressive levels of detail.", từ "progressive" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "DFDs use a functional decomposition approach, subdividing a complex problem into progressive levels of detail.", what does "progressive" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: progressive /prəˈɡres.ɪv/ (tính từ): tăng dần theo từng bước. "Progressive levels of detail" = các mức chi tiết tăng dần; "progressive refinement" cũng dùng nghĩa này.
items.explanationEn: progressive /prəˈɡres.ɪv/ (adjective): developing step by step. "Progressive levels of detail" become more detailed step by step, as in "progressive refinement".

items.question: Trong câu "DFDs give a holistic view of how data moves through a system — something other models do NOT show well.", từ "holistic" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "DFDs give a holistic view of how data moves through a system — something other models do NOT show well.", what does "holistic" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: holistic /həʊˈlɪs.tɪk/ (tính từ): tổng thể, toàn diện. "A holistic view" = cái nhìn tổng thể, xem xét mọi phần trong mối liên hệ với nhau.
items.explanationEn: holistic /həʊˈlɪs.tɪk/ (adjective): seeing the whole together. "A holistic view" considers all parts and how they relate as a whole.

items.question: Trong câu "But DFDs are not sufficient alone: the details of how data is transformed are better shown through the steps within a process, using use cases or swimlane diagrams.", từ "sufficient" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "But DFDs are not sufficient alone: the details of how data is transformed are better shown through the steps within a process, using use cases or swimlane diagrams.", what does "sufficient" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: sufficient /səˈfɪʃ.ənt/ (tính từ): đủ, đáp ứng được. Trái nghĩa: "insufficient". Cặp "necessary and sufficient" = cần và đủ.
items.explanationEn: sufficient /səˈfɪʃ.ənt/ (adjective): enough for the purpose. Opposite: "insufficient". "Necessary and sufficient" is a common pairing.

items.question: Trong câu "The level 0 DFD partitions the system into its major processes.", từ "partition" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The level 0 DFD partitions the system into its major processes.", what does "partition" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: partition /pɑːˈtɪʃ.ən/ (động từ): chia tách thành các phần. Cấu trúc "partition X into Y"; cũng dùng cho ổ đĩa ("partition a disk") và cơ sở dữ liệu.
items.explanationEn: partition /pɑːˈtɪʃ.ən/ (verb): to divide into parts. Pattern: "partition X into Y"; also used for disks and database tables.

items.question: Trong câu "Using models to enhance communication matters more than dogmatically obeying these guidelines.", từ "dogmatically" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Using models to enhance communication matters more than dogmatically obeying these guidelines.", what does "dogmatically" (adverb) mean?
options: một cách cứng nhắc, giáo điều
items.explanation: dogmatically /dɒɡˈmæt.ɪ.kli/ (trạng từ): một cách cứng nhắc, giáo điều. Tính từ "dogmatic" = giáo điều; ý câu: đừng tuân theo quy tắc một cách máy móc.
items.explanationEn: dogmatically /dɒɡˈmæt.ɪ.kli/ (adverb): rigidly, without questioning. The adjective is "dogmatic"; the point is not to follow rules mechanically.

items.question: Trong câu "Do not try to imply processing sequence with a DFD.", từ "imply" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Do not try to imply processing sequence with a DFD.", what does "imply" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: imply /ɪmˈplaɪ/ (động từ): ngụ ý, ám chỉ. Đừng nhầm với "infer" (suy ra): người nói "imply", người nghe "infer".
items.explanationEn: imply /ɪmˈplaɪ/ (verb): to suggest without stating. Do not confuse with "infer": a speaker implies, a listener infers.

items.question: Trong câu "Name processes with a concise action: a verb plus an object", từ "concise" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Name processes with a concise action: a verb plus an object", what does "concise" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: concise /kənˈsaɪs/ (tính từ): ngắn gọn, súc tích. Tài liệu tốt nên "clear and concise" (rõ ràng và súc tích).
items.explanationEn: concise /kənˈsaɪs/ (adjective): short and clear. Good documentation is often described as "clear and concise".

items.question: Trong câu "A bubble with only inputs or only outputs is suspicious.", từ "suspicious" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A bubble with only inputs or only outputs is suspicious.", what does "suspicious" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: suspicious /səˈspɪʃ.əs/ (tính từ): đáng ngờ, có thể sai. Về sự vật: đáng ngờ ("suspicious activity"); về người: hay nghi ngờ ("suspicious of strangers").
items.explanationEn: suspicious /səˈspɪʃ.əs/ (adjective): likely to be wrong. Of things it means raising doubt ("suspicious activity"); of people, distrustful ("suspicious of strangers").

items.question: Trong câu "A business process reengineering team set a goal of a tenfold reduction in the time to incorporate a new chemical into a product.", từ "incorporate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A business process reengineering team set a goal of a tenfold reduction in the time to incorporate a new chemical into a product.", what does "incorporate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: incorporate /ɪnˈkɔː.pər.eɪt/ (động từ): đưa vào, tích hợp. Cấu trúc "incorporate X into Y"; "incorporated" (Inc.) còn là công ty đã đăng ký pháp nhân.
items.explanationEn: incorporate /ɪnˈkɔː.pər.eɪt/ (verb): to include as a part. Pattern: "incorporate X into Y"; "incorporated" (Inc.) also describes a legally formed company.

items.question: Trong câu "They are a variation on the flowchart, divided into visual elements called lanes.", từ "variation" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "They are a variation on the flowchart, divided into visual elements called lanes.", what does "variation" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: variation /ˌveə.riˈeɪ.ʃən/ (danh từ): biến thể, dạng khác. "A variation on X" = một biến thể của X; "variation in prices" lại là sự thay đổi, dao động.
items.explanationEn: variation /ˌveə.riˈeɪ.ʃən/ (noun): a slightly different form. "A variation on X" is a modified form of X; "variation in prices" means change in amount.

items.question: Trong câu "Sketching a business process as a swimlane diagram is a great starting point for elicitation conversations.", từ "elicitation" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Sketching a business process as a swimlane diagram is a great starting point for elicitation conversations.", what does "elicitation" (noun) mean?
options: việc khơi gợi, thu thập (yêu cầu)
items.explanation: elicitation /iˌlɪs.ɪˈteɪ.ʃən/ (danh từ): việc khơi gợi, thu thập (yêu cầu). Động từ "elicit" = khơi gợi; "requirements elicitation" = thu thập yêu cầu từ các bên liên quan.
items.explanationEn: elicitation /iˌlɪs.ɪˈteɪ.ʃən/ (noun): drawing out information from people. The verb is "elicit"; "requirements elicitation" gathers needs from stakeholders.

items.question: Trong câu "A complete business process might not fall entirely within the scope of one software system.", từ "fall within" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A complete business process might not fall entirely within the scope of one software system.", what does "fall within" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: fall within /fɔːl wɪˈðɪn/ (cụm từ): nằm trong (phạm vi). Cụm cố định: "fall within/outside the scope" = nằm trong/ngoài phạm vi.
items.explanationEn: fall within /fɔːl wɪˈðɪn/ (phrase): to be inside a range. Fixed phrase: "fall within/outside the scope".

items.question: Trong câu "They help tie together the functional requirements that let users perform a specific task.", từ "tie together" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "They help tie together the functional requirements that let users perform a specific task.", what does "tie together" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: tie together /taɪ təˈɡeð.ər/ (cụm từ): liên kết lại với nhau. Nghĩa bóng: gắn kết các phần rời rạc thành một tổng thể có ý nghĩa.
items.explanationEn: tie together /taɪ təˈɡeð.ər/ (phrase): to connect into a whole. Figuratively, it connects separate pieces into a meaningful whole.

items.question: Trong câu "Real-time systems and process control applications exist at any moment in only one of a finite number of states.", từ "finite" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Real-time systems and process control applications exist at any moment in only one of a finite number of states.", what does "finite" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: finite /ˈfaɪ.naɪt/ (tính từ): hữu hạn. "Finite state machine" = máy trạng thái hữu hạn; trái nghĩa "infinite".
items.explanationEn: finite /ˈfaɪ.naɪt/ (adjective): limited in number. As in "finite state machine"; the opposite is "infinite".

items.question: Trong câu "State changes take place only when well-defined criteria are satisfied — such as receiving a specific input signal under certain conditions.", từ "criterion" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "State changes take place only when well-defined criteria are satisfied — such as receiving a specific input signal under certain conditions.", what does "criterion" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: criterion /kraɪˈtɪə.ri.ən/ (danh từ): tiêu chí. Số nhiều bất quy tắc: criterion → criteria; "acceptance criteria" = tiêu chí chấp nhận.
items.explanationEn: criterion /kraɪˈtɪə.ri.ən/ (noun): a standard for judging. Irregular plural: criterion → criteria; see "acceptance criteria".

items.question: Trong câu "Describing a complex set of state changes in natural language creates a high probability that you will overlook a permitted change or include a forbidden one.", từ "overlook" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Describing a complex set of state changes in natural language creates a high probability that you will overlook a permitted change or include a forbidden one.", what does "overlook" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: overlook /ˌəʊ.vəˈlʊk/ (động từ): bỏ sót, không để ý. "Overlook a detail" = sơ ý bỏ qua; "a room overlooking the sea" lại là nhìn ra biển.
items.explanationEn: overlook /ˌəʊ.vəˈlʊk/ (verb): to fail to notice. "Overlook a detail" means miss it; "a room overlooking the sea" has a view of it.

items.question: Trong câu "Depending on how the SRS is organized, the requirements associated with state-dependent behaviour could be scattered throughout the document, making it hard to gain an overall understanding of system behaviour.", từ "scattered" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Depending on how the SRS is organized, the requirements associated with state-dependent behaviour could be scattered throughout the document, making it hard to gain an overall understanding of system behaviour.", what does "scattered" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: scattered /ˈskæt.əd/ (tính từ): rải rác, phân tán. "Scattered throughout the document" = nằm rải rác khắp tài liệu, khó theo dõi.
items.explanationEn: scattered /ˈskæt.əd/ (adjective): spread over a wide area. "Scattered throughout the document" means spread in many places, hard to follow.

items.question: Trong câu "A state table presents all possible transitions as a matrix.", từ "matrix" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A state table presents all possible transitions as a matrix.", what does "matrix" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a grid of rows and columns
items.explanation: matrix /ˈmeɪ.trɪks/ (danh từ): bảng dạng hàng và cột. Số nhiều: matrices. Ví dụ khác: "traceability matrix", "CRUD matrix".
items.explanationEn: matrix /ˈmeɪ.trɪks/ (noun): a grid of rows and columns. Plural: matrices. Other examples: "traceability matrix", "CRUD matrix".

items.question: Trong câu "This underscores the value of representing requirements information at multiple levels of abstraction.", từ "underscore" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "This underscores the value of representing requirements information at multiple levels of abstraction.", what does "underscore" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to draw a line under text
items.explanation: underscore /ˌʌn.dəˈskɔːr/ (động từ): nhấn mạnh, làm nổi bật. Đồng nghĩa "highlight", "emphasise"; danh từ "underscore" còn là ký tự gạch dưới (_).
items.explanationEn: underscore /ˌʌn.dəˈskɔːr/ (verb): to emphasise. Synonym of "highlight"; as a noun it is also the "_" character.

items.question: Trong câu "They help developers understand the intended behaviour, facilitate early testing because testers can derive tests covering all permitted transition paths, and help ensure all necessary states and transitions are correctly and completely described in the functional requirements.", từ "facilitate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "They help developers understand the intended behaviour, facilitate early testing because testers can derive tests covering all permitted transition paths, and help ensure all necessary states and transitions are correctly and completely described in the functional requirements.", what does "facilitate" (verb) mean?
options: tạo điều kiện, làm dễ dàng
items.explanation: facilitate /fəˈsɪl.ɪ.teɪt/ (động từ): tạo điều kiện, làm dễ dàng. "Facilitator" = người điều phối buổi họp/workshop, giúp buổi làm việc diễn ra suôn sẻ.
items.explanationEn: facilitate /fəˈsɪl.ɪ.teɪt/ (verb): to make easier. A "facilitator" runs a meeting or workshop so it goes smoothly.

items.question: Trong câu "They help developers understand the intended behaviour, facilitate early testing because testers can derive tests covering all permitted transition paths, and help ensure all necessary states and transitions are correctly and completely described in the functional requirements.", từ "derive" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "They help developers understand the intended behaviour, facilitate early testing because testers can derive tests covering all permitted transition paths, and help ensure all necessary states and transitions are correctly and completely described in the functional requirements.", what does "derive" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: derive /dɪˈraɪv/ (động từ): suy ra, rút ra từ. Cấu trúc "derive X from Y"; "derived requirement" = yêu cầu suy ra từ yêu cầu khác.
items.explanationEn: derive /dɪˈraɪv/ (verb): to obtain from a source. Pattern: "derive X from Y"; a "derived requirement" comes from another requirement.

items.question: Trong câu "State models give a high-level view spanning several use cases or user stories, each of which might effect a transition.", từ "span" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "State models give a high-level view spanning several use cases or user stories, each of which might effect a transition.", what does "span" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: span /spæn/ (động từ): trải dài qua, bao phủ. Danh từ "span" = khoảng (thời gian/không gian): "attention span", "time span".
items.explanationEn: span /spæn/ (verb): to extend across. As a noun it means an extent: "attention span", "time span".

items.question: Trong câu "State models give a high-level view spanning several use cases or user stories, each of which might effect a transition.", từ "effect" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "State models give a high-level view spanning several use cases or user stories, each of which might effect a transition.", what does "effect" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: effect /ɪˈfekt/ (động từ): gây ra, tạo ra. Động từ "effect" = làm cho xảy ra ("effect a change"); khác "affect" = ảnh hưởng đến.
items.explanationEn: effect /ɪˈfekt/ (verb): to bring about. The verb "effect" means to cause ("effect a change"); "affect" means to influence.

items.question: Trong câu "a user interface can be regarded as a series of state changes.", từ "regard as" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "a user interface can be regarded as a series of state changes.", what does "regard as" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: regard as /rɪˈɡɑːd æz/ (cụm từ): được xem như, coi là. Cấu trúc bị động "be regarded as + danh từ" rất phổ biến trong văn học thuật.
items.explanationEn: regard as /rɪˈɡɑːd æz/ (phrase): to think of as. The passive "be regarded as + noun" is very common in academic writing.

items.question: Trong câu "The SRS should specify that this function will be available, but drawing many help screen boxes clutters the model while adding little value.", từ "clutter" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The SRS should specify that this function will be available, but drawing many help screen boxes clutters the model while adding little value.", what does "clutter" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: clutter /ˈklʌt.ər/ (động từ): làm rối, làm lộn xộn. "Cluttered UI" = giao diện rối mắt vì quá nhiều thành phần; "declutter" = dọn cho gọn.
items.explanationEn: clutter /ˈklʌt.ər/ (verb): to make messy. A "cluttered UI" has too many elements; "declutter" means to tidy it.

items.question: Trong câu "A dialog map lets you explore hypothetical interface concepts based on your understanding of the requirements.", từ "hypothetical" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A dialog map lets you explore hypothetical interface concepts based on your understanding of the requirements.", what does "hypothetical" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: hypothetical /ˌhaɪ.pəˈθet.ɪ.kəl/ (tính từ): giả định, chưa có thật. "A hypothetical scenario" = tình huống giả định; danh từ gốc "hypothesis" = giả thuyết.
items.explanationEn: hypothetical /ˌhaɪ.pəˈθet.ɪ.kəl/ (adjective): imagined, not yet real. As in "a hypothetical scenario"; the related noun is "hypothesis".

items.question: Trong câu "The dialog map captures the ESSENCE of user-system interaction and task flow WITHOUT bogging the team down in detailed screen layouts.", từ "bog down" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The dialog map captures the ESSENCE of user-system interaction and task flow WITHOUT bogging the team down in detailed screen layouts.", what does "bog down" (phrase) mean?
options: làm sa lầy, làm chậm tiến độ
items.explanation: bog down /bɒɡ daʊn/ (cụm từ): làm sa lầy, làm chậm tiến độ. Thường ở bị động: "get bogged down in details" = sa lầy vào chi tiết.
items.explanationEn: bog down /bɒɡ daʊn/ (phrase): to slow progress with detail. Often passive: "get bogged down in details".

items.question: Trong câu "certain dialog map transitions let the user back out of an operation they are performing.", từ "back out of" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "certain dialog map transitions let the user back out of an operation they are performing.", what does "back out of" (phrase) mean?
options: rút lui, huỷ bỏ giữa chừng
items.explanation: back out of /bæk aʊt əv/ (cụm từ): rút lui, huỷ bỏ giữa chừng. "Back out of a deal/operation" = rút lui khỏi thoả thuận hoặc thao tác đang làm.
items.explanationEn: back out of /bæk aʊt əv/ (phrase): to withdraw before finishing. "Back out of a deal or operation" means withdraw from it.

items.question: Trong câu "do NOT try to pin down every detail of the interface design at requirements time.", từ "pin down" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "do NOT try to pin down every detail of the interface design at requirements time.", what does "pin down" (phrase) mean?
options: xác định chính xác, chốt lại
items.explanation: pin down /pɪn daʊn/ (cụm từ): xác định chính xác, chốt lại. "Pin down the requirements" = chốt yêu cầu cụ thể, rõ ràng.
items.explanationEn: pin down /pɪn daʊn/ (phrase): to define exactly. "Pin down the requirements" means make them specific and definite.

items.question: Trong câu "Software is often dominated by complex logic, with numerous combinations of conditions leading to different behaviours.", từ "dominate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Software is often dominated by complex logic, with numerous combinations of conditions leading to different behaviours.", what does "dominate" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to rule over people by force
to be the main feature of
items.explanation: dominate /ˈdɒm.ɪ.neɪt/ (động từ): chiếm phần lớn, chi phối. "Dominated by" = bị chi phối, chủ yếu gồm; tính từ "dominant" = chiếm ưu thế.
items.explanationEn: dominate /ˈdɒm.ɪ.neɪt/ (verb): to be the main feature of. "Dominated by" means mostly made up of; the adjective is "dominant".

items.question: Trong câu "Each factor has two conditions, in principle giving 2⁴ = 16 combinations of true and false, implying up to 16 distinct functional requirements.", từ "in principle" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Each factor has two conditions, in principle giving 2⁴ = 16 combinations of true and false, implying up to 16 distinct functional requirements.", what does "in principle" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: in principle /ɪn ˈprɪn.sə.pəl/ (cụm từ): về mặt lý thuyết. Thường đối lập với "in practice" (trên thực tế) — đúng như câu tiếp theo trong bài.
items.explanationEn: in principle /ɪn ˈprɪn.sə.pəl/ (phrase): in theory. Often contrasted with "in practice", exactly as the next sentence in the article does.

items.question: Trong câu "Each factor has two conditions, in principle giving 2⁴ = 16 combinations of true and false, implying up to 16 distinct functional requirements.", từ "distinct" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Each factor has two conditions, in principle giving 2⁴ = 16 combinations of true and false, implying up to 16 distinct functional requirements.", what does "distinct" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: distinct /dɪˈstɪŋkt/ (tính từ): riêng biệt, khác nhau. Đừng nhầm với "distinctive" (đặc trưng); "distinct values" = các giá trị khác nhau.
items.explanationEn: distinct /dɪˈstɪŋkt/ (adjective): separate and different. Not the same as "distinctive"; "distinct values" are different from each other.

items.question: Trong câu "If the user is not authorized to request chemicals, the system will not accept the request, so the remaining conditions become irrelevant — shown as dashes in the decision table cells.", từ "irrelevant" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "If the user is not authorized to request chemicals, the system will not accept the request, so the remaining conditions become irrelevant — shown as dashes in the decision table cells.", what does "irrelevant" (adjective) mean?
options: không liên quan, không ảnh hưởng
items.explanation: irrelevant /ɪˈrel.ə.vənt/ (tính từ): không liên quan, không ảnh hưởng. "Irrelevant condition" = điều kiện không ảnh hưởng đến kết quả; trái nghĩa "relevant".
items.explanationEn: irrelevant /ɪˈrel.ə.vənt/ (adjective): not affecting the outcome. An "irrelevant condition" does not affect the result; opposite: "relevant".

items.question: Trong câu "Even a complex decision table or decision tree is EASIER TO READ than a block of repetitive textual requirements.", từ "repetitive" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Even a complex decision table or decision tree is EASIER TO READ than a block of repetitive textual requirements.", what does "repetitive" (adjective) mean?
optionsEn: saying the same again and again
items.explanation: repetitive /rɪˈpet.ə.tɪv/ (tính từ): lặp đi lặp lại. "Repetitive tasks" = công việc lặp lại, thường nên tự động hoá.
items.explanationEn: repetitive /rɪˈpet.ə.tɪv/ (adjective): saying the same again and again. "Repetitive tasks" are often good candidates for automation.

items.question: Trong câu "An event is some change or activity that takes place in the user environment that stimulates a response from the software system.", từ "stimulate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "An event is some change or activity that takes place in the user environment that stimulates a response from the software system.", what does "stimulate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: stimulate /ˈstɪm.jə.leɪt/ (động từ): kích hoạt, gây ra. Đừng nhầm với "simulate" (mô phỏng); "stimulate discussion" = khơi gợi thảo luận.
items.explanationEn: stimulate /ˈstɪm.jə.leɪt/ (verb): to cause a reaction. Do not confuse with "simulate"; "stimulate discussion" means to encourage it.

items.question: Trong câu "An event-response table lists all such events along with the behaviour the system is expected to exhibit in reaction to each.", từ "exhibit" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "An event-response table lists all such events along with the behaviour the system is expected to exhibit in reaction to each.", what does "exhibit" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: exhibit /ɪɡˈzɪb.ɪt/ (động từ): thể hiện, biểu hiện. "Exhibit behaviour/symptoms" = biểu hiện hành vi/triệu chứng; danh từ "exhibition" = triển lãm.
items.explanationEn: exhibit /ɪɡˈzɪb.ɪt/ (verb): to show a quality. "Exhibit behaviour or symptoms" means show them; "exhibition" is a public display.

items.question: Trong câu "For instance, with an automobile windshield wiper system, the driver setting the switch to intermittent leads to slightly different behaviour depending on whether the wipers are on or off at that moment.", từ "intermittent" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "For instance, with an automobile windshield wiper system, the driver setting the switch to intermittent leads to slightly different behaviour depending on whether the wipers are on or off at that moment.", what does "intermittent" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: intermittent /ˌɪn.təˈmɪt.ənt/ (tính từ): ngắt quãng, không liên tục. "Intermittent bug" = lỗi lúc có lúc không, rất khó tái hiện.
items.explanationEn: intermittent /ˌɪn.təˈmɪt.ənt/ (adjective): stopping and starting. An "intermittent bug" appears only sometimes and is hard to reproduce.

items.question: Trong câu "Is the intermittent mode continuously variable, or does it have discrete settings?", từ "discrete" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Is the intermittent mode continuously variable, or does it have discrete settings?", what does "discrete" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: discrete /dɪˈskriːt/ (tính từ): rời rạc, tách biệt. "Discrete" (rời rạc) khác "discreet" (kín đáo) dù phát âm giống nhau.
items.explanationEn: discrete /dɪˈskriːt/ (adjective): separate and distinct. "Discrete" (separate) and "discreet" (tactful) sound the same but differ in meaning.

items.question: Trong câu "If you leave out this kind of information, the developer either has to hunt it down or make it up.", từ "make up" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "If you leave out this kind of information, the developer either has to hunt it down or make it up.", what does "make up" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: make up /meɪk ʌp/ (cụm từ): bịa ra, tự nghĩ ra. "Make it up" ở đây = tự bịa ra thông tin; "make up 20%" lại là chiếm, tạo thành.
items.explanationEn: make up /meɪk ʌp/ (phrase): to invent. Here "make it up" means invent it; "make up 20%" means form a part of.

items.question: Trong câu "Writing requirements at this essential level avoids imposing unnecessary design constraints — but do record any known design constraints to guide the designer thinking.", từ "impose" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Writing requirements at this essential level avoids imposing unnecessary design constraints — but do record any known design constraints to guide the designer thinking.", what does "impose" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: impose /ɪmˈpəʊz/ (động từ): áp đặt. Cấu trúc "impose X on Y": "impose constraints on the design" (áp đặt ràng buộc lên thiết kế).
items.explanationEn: impose /ɪmˈpəʊz/ (verb): to force upon. Pattern: "impose X on Y", e.g. "impose constraints on the design".

items.question: Trong câu "They represent individual instances created from a general template called a class.", từ "instance" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "They represent individual instances created from a general template called a class.", what does "instance" (noun) mean?
options: thể hiện, đối tượng cụ thể
items.explanation: instance /ˈɪn.stəns/ (danh từ): thể hiện, đối tượng cụ thể. Trong OOP, object là "instance" của class; "for instance" lại là cụm "ví dụ như".
items.explanationEn: instance /ˈɪn.stəns/ (noun): a single concrete case. In OOP an object is an instance of a class; "for instance" means "for example".

items.question: Trong câu "EVERY project should exploit requirements models to analyse requirements from multiple perspectives, regardless of the development approach.", từ "exploit" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "EVERY project should exploit requirements models to analyse requirements from multiple perspectives, regardless of the development approach.", what does "exploit" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: exploit /ɪkˈsplɔɪt/ (động từ): tận dụng, khai thác. Nghĩa tích cực: tận dụng tối đa; trong bảo mật, "exploit a vulnerability" = khai thác lỗ hổng.
items.explanationEn: exploit /ɪkˈsplɔɪt/ (verb): to make full use of. Positive sense: make full use of; in security, "exploit a vulnerability" means attack it.

items.question: Trong câu "EVERY project should exploit requirements models to analyse requirements from multiple perspectives, regardless of the development approach.", từ "regardless of" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "EVERY project should exploit requirements models to analyse requirements from multiple perspectives, regardless of the development approach.", what does "regardless of" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: regardless of /rɪˈɡɑːd.ləs əv/ (cụm từ): bất kể, không phụ thuộc. "Regardless of + danh từ" = bất kể; đối lập với "depending on" (tuỳ thuộc vào).
items.explanationEn: regardless of /rɪˈɡɑːd.ləs əv/ (phrase): without depending on. "Regardless of + noun" contrasts with "depending on".

items.question: Trong câu "Create models in a less durable or less polished format: sketch on a whiteboard and take a photograph, without necessarily storing them in a formal requirements document or modeling tool.", từ "durable" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Create models in a less durable or less polished format: sketch on a whiteboard and take a photograph, without necessarily storing them in a formal requirements document or modeling tool.", what does "durable" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: durable /ˈdjʊə.rə.bəl/ (tính từ): lâu bền, lưu giữ lâu. Trong hệ thống: "durable storage" = lưu trữ bền vững, không mất khi sự cố.
items.explanationEn: durable /ˈdjʊə.rə.bəl/ (adjective): lasting a long time. In systems, "durable storage" survives failures.

items.question: Trong câu "Do not rule out any model just because you are on an agile project.", từ "rule out" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Do not rule out any model just because you are on an agile project.", what does "rule out" (phrase) mean?
optionsEn: to draw lines with a ruler
items.explanation: rule out /ruːl aʊt/ (cụm từ): loại trừ, gạt bỏ. "Rule out a possibility" = loại trừ một khả năng.
items.explanationEn: rule out /ruːl aʊt/ (phrase): to exclude as an option. "Rule out a possibility" means exclude it.

items.question: Trong câu "A team of three developers occasionally, inadvertently used different variable names, lengths, and validation criteria for the SAME data item.", từ "inadvertently" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A team of three developers occasionally, inadvertently used different variable names, lengths, and validation criteria for the SAME data item.", what does "inadvertently" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: inadvertently /ˌɪn.ədˈvɜː.tənt.li/ (trạng từ): vô tình, không cố ý. Đồng nghĩa "unintentionally", "accidentally"; hay dùng khi mô tả lỗi.
items.explanationEn: inadvertently /ˌɪn.ədˈvɜː.tənt.li/ (adverb): without meaning to. Synonyms: "unintentionally", "accidentally"; common when describing mistakes.

items.question: Trong câu "Bad things can happen when you convert back and forth between data items of different lengths: you can overwrite other data, pick up garbage padding characters at the end, have improperly terminated character strings, and even overwrite program code, ultimately causing system crashes.", từ "back and forth" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Bad things can happen when you convert back and forth between data items of different lengths: you can overwrite other data, pick up garbage padding characters at the end, have improperly terminated character strings, and even overwrite program code, ultimately causing system crashes.", what does "back and forth" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: back and forth /bæk ən fɔːθ/ (cụm từ): qua lại nhiều lần. "Go back and forth" = qua lại; "emails going back and forth" = trao đổi email qua lại.
items.explanationEn: back and forth /bæk ən fɔːθ/ (phrase): repeatedly in both directions. As in "emails going back and forth" between two people.

items.question: Trong câu "Bad things can happen when you convert back and forth between data items of different lengths: you can overwrite other data, pick up garbage padding characters at the end, have improperly terminated character strings, and even overwrite program code, ultimately causing system crashes.", từ "overwrite" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Bad things can happen when you convert back and forth between data items of different lengths: you can overwrite other data, pick up garbage padding characters at the end, have improperly terminated character strings, and even overwrite program code, ultimately causing system crashes.", what does "overwrite" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: overwrite /ˌəʊ.vəˈraɪt/ (động từ): ghi đè lên. "Overwrite a file" = ghi đè tệp, dữ liệu cũ bị mất.
items.explanationEn: overwrite /ˌəʊ.vəˈraɪt/ (verb): to replace stored data. "Overwrite a file" replaces its old content, which is lost.

items.question: Trong câu "As soon as the team began defining and managing their data more rigorously, all those problems went away.", từ "rigorously" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "As soon as the team began defining and managing their data more rigorously, all those problems went away.", what does "rigorously" (adverb) mean?
options: một cách chặt chẽ, nghiêm ngặt
items.explanation: rigorously /ˈrɪɡ.ər.əs.li/ (trạng từ): một cách chặt chẽ, nghiêm ngặt. Tính từ "rigorous": "a rigorous review", "rigorous testing" (kiểm thử nghiêm ngặt).
items.explanationEn: rigorously /ˈrɪɡ.ər.əs.li/ (adverb): strictly and thoroughly. Adjective "rigorous": "a rigorous review", "rigorous testing".

items.question: Trong câu "Consolidating information about composition, data types, and allowed values into one shared resource establishes the data validation criteria, helps developers write correct programs, and minimises integration problems.", từ "consolidate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Consolidating information about composition, data types, and allowed values into one shared resource establishes the data validation criteria, helps developers write correct programs, and minimises integration problems.", what does "consolidate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: consolidate /kənˈsɒl.ɪ.deɪt/ (động từ): hợp nhất, gom lại. "Consolidate X into Y" = gom X thành một Y; "consolidate power" lại là củng cố quyền lực.
items.explanationEn: consolidate /kənˈsɒl.ɪ.deɪt/ (verb): to combine into one. "Consolidate X into Y" means combine; "consolidate power" means strengthen it.

items.question: Trong câu "A separate data dictionary makes it easy to find the information you need while avoiding redundancy and inconsistency.", từ "redundancy" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A separate data dictionary makes it easy to find the information you need while avoiding redundancy and inconsistency.", what does "redundancy" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: redundancy /rɪˈdʌn.dən.si/ (danh từ): sự trùng lặp, dư thừa. Trong dữ liệu là trùng lặp không cần thiết; trong hạ tầng "redundancy" lại là dự phòng có chủ đích; tiếng Anh-Anh còn nghĩa là bị sa thải.
items.explanationEn: redundancy /rɪˈdʌn.dən.si/ (noun): unnecessary repetition. In data it is needless duplication; in infrastructure it is deliberate backup; in British English it also means being laid off.

items.question: Trong câu "It is also hard to maintain the integrity of duplicated data structures as they evolve.", từ "integrity" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "It is also hard to maintain the integrity of duplicated data structures as they evolve.", what does "integrity" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: integrity /ɪnˈteɡ.rə.ti/ (danh từ): tính toàn vẹn, nhất quán. "Data integrity" = tính toàn vẹn dữ liệu; "a person of integrity" = người chính trực.
items.explanationEn: integrity /ɪnˈteɡ.rə.ti/ (noun): being whole and consistent. "Data integrity" means correct, consistent data; "a person of integrity" is honest.

items.question: Trong câu "If you do NOT keep it current, it will misleadingly suggest information that is out of date, and team members will stop trusting it.", từ "misleadingly" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "If you do NOT keep it current, it will misleadingly suggest information that is out of date, and team members will stop trusting it.", what does "misleadingly" (adverb) mean?
optionsEn: in a way that gives a false idea
items.explanation: misleadingly /ˌmɪsˈliː.dɪŋ.li/ (trạng từ): một cách gây hiểu lầm. Từ gốc "mislead" = làm hiểu sai; "misleading data" = dữ liệu gây hiểu lầm.
items.explanationEn: misleadingly /ˌmɪsˈliː.dɪŋ.li/ (adverb): in a way that gives a false idea. From "mislead"; "misleading data" gives a false impression.

items.question: Trong câu "Other data dictionary columns describe the data type, length, range of values, list of allowed values, and other pertinent attributes.", từ "pertinent" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Other data dictionary columns describe the data type, length, range of values, list of allowed values, and other pertinent attributes.", what does "pertinent" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: pertinent /ˈpɜː.tɪ.nənt/ (tính từ): liên quan, thích đáng. Trang trọng hơn "relevant": "pertinent information", "pertinent to the discussion".
items.explanationEn: pertinent /ˈpɜː.tɪ.nənt/ (adjective): relevant to the matter. A formal synonym of "relevant": "pertinent to the discussion".

items.question: Trong câu "If an element in a structure is optional (the user or system is not required to supply a value), enclose it in parentheses.", từ "enclose" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "If an element in a structure is optional (the user or system is not required to supply a value), enclose it in parentheses.", what does "enclose" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: enclose /ɪnˈkləʊz/ (động từ): đặt vào trong (dấu ngoặc). "Enclose in quotes/brackets" = đặt trong dấu nháy/ngoặc; "please find enclosed" = gửi kèm.
items.explanationEn: enclose /ɪnˈkləʊz/ (verb): to put inside brackets. "Enclose in quotes" means surround with them; "please find enclosed" means attached.

items.question: Trong câu "means the structure must contain at least three instances with no upper bound.", từ "upper bound" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "means the structure must contain at least three instances with no upper bound.", what does "upper bound" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: upper bound /ˈʌp.ə baʊnd/ (cụm từ): giới hạn trên. Cặp đôi "lower bound / upper bound" = cận dưới / cận trên.
items.explanationEn: upper bound /ˈʌp.ə baʊnd/ (phrase): a maximum limit. Paired with "lower bound"; together they define a range.

items.question: Trong câu "The matrix correlates system actions with data entities, showing where and how each significant data entity is created, read, updated, and deleted.", từ "correlate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The matrix correlates system actions with data entities, showing where and how each significant data entity is created, read, updated, and deleted.", what does "correlate" (verb) mean?
options: đối chiếu, liên hệ với nhau
items.explanation: correlate /ˈkɒr.ə.leɪt/ (động từ): đối chiếu, liên hệ với nhau. Cấu trúc "correlate X with Y"; danh từ "correlation" = mối tương quan.
items.explanationEn: correlate /ˈkɒr.ə.leɪt/ (verb): to show a relationship between. Pattern: "correlate X with Y"; noun: "correlation".

items.question: Trong câu "Report specification straddles the requirements/design boundary", từ "straddle" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Report specification straddles the requirements/design boundary", what does "straddle" (verb) mean?
options: nằm vắt qua cả hai bên
optionsEn: to sit with legs on each side
items.explanation: straddle /ˈstræd.əl/ (động từ): nằm vắt qua cả hai bên. Nghĩa bóng: thuộc về cả hai lĩnh vực cùng lúc, như báo cáo vừa là yêu cầu vừa là thiết kế.
items.explanationEn: straddle /ˈstræd.əl/ (verb): to lie across both sides. Figuratively, belonging to two areas at once, as reports do with requirements and design.

items.question: Trong câu "You might need to change the layout from portrait to landscape, or transpose the information from columns to rows.", từ "landscape" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "You might need to change the layout from portrait to landscape, or transpose the information from columns to rows.", what does "landscape" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: landscape /ˈlænd.skeɪp/ (danh từ): khổ ngang (trang giấy). Hướng trang: "portrait" (dọc) và "landscape" (ngang); "the tech landscape" lại là toàn cảnh ngành.
items.explanationEn: landscape /ˈlænd.skeɪp/ (noun): a wider-than-tall page layout. Page orientation: portrait (tall) vs landscape (wide); "the tech landscape" means the overall situation.

items.question: Trong câu "Use plausible data in the mock-up so the prototype experience is realistic to evaluators.", từ "plausible" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Use plausible data in the mock-up so the prototype experience is realistic to evaluators.", what does "plausible" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: plausible /ˈplɔː.zə.bəl/ (tính từ): hợp lý, trông như thật. "A plausible explanation" = lời giải thích nghe hợp lý; trái nghĩa "implausible".
items.explanationEn: plausible /ˈplɔː.zə.bəl/ (adjective): seeming reasonable or real. "A plausible explanation" sounds reasonable; opposite: "implausible".

items.question: Trong câu "Stock trading applications display an array of charts and data that is overwhelming to a novice, yet a skilled eye can scan and process it in a glance.", từ "array" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Stock trading applications display an array of charts and data that is overwhelming to a novice, yet a skilled eye can scan and process it in a glance.", what does "array" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: array /əˈreɪ/ (danh từ): một loạt, nhiều thứ. "An array of + danh từ số nhiều" = một loạt, rất nhiều; trong lập trình "array" là mảng.
items.explanationEn: array /əˈreɪ/ (noun): a large collection. "An array of + plural noun" means a wide range; in programming it is a data structure.

items.question: Trong câu "Stock trading applications display an array of charts and data that is overwhelming to a novice, yet a skilled eye can scan and process it in a glance.", từ "novice" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Stock trading applications display an array of charts and data that is overwhelming to a novice, yet a skilled eye can scan and process it in a glance.", what does "novice" (noun) mean?
options: người mới, người chưa có kinh nghiệm
items.explanation: novice /ˈnɒv.ɪs/ (danh từ): người mới, người chưa có kinh nghiệm. Đồng nghĩa "beginner", "newcomer"; trái nghĩa "expert".
items.explanationEn: novice /ˈnɒv.ɪs/ (noun): a beginner. Synonyms: "beginner", "newcomer"; opposite: "expert".

items.question: Trong câu "Companies often use dashboards to aggregate information about sales, expenses, and key performance indicators (KPIs).", từ "aggregate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Companies often use dashboards to aggregate information about sales, expenses, and key performance indicators (KPIs).", what does "aggregate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: aggregate /ˈæɡ.rɪ.ɡeɪt/ (động từ): tổng hợp, gom lại. Trong SQL, "aggregate functions" (SUM, COUNT, AVG) tổng hợp nhiều dòng thành một giá trị.
items.explanationEn: aggregate /ˈæɡ.rɪ.ɡeɪt/ (verb): to combine into a total. In SQL, "aggregate functions" such as SUM and COUNT combine many rows into one value.

items.question: Trong câu "How should the user customisations persist across sessions?", từ "persist" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "How should the user customisations persist across sessions?", what does "persist" (verb) mean?
options: được lưu giữ, tồn tại lâu
items.explanation: persist /pəˈsɪst/ (động từ): được lưu giữ, tồn tại lâu. Với dữ liệu, "persist" = được lưu lại (persistence); với người = kiên trì.
items.explanationEn: persist /pəˈsɪst/ (verb): to remain stored over time. For data it means remain stored (persistence); for people it means keep trying.

items.question: Trong câu "The more willing you are to delegate detail to designers, the less information you need in the requirements.", từ "delegate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The more willing you are to delegate detail to designers, the less information you need in the requirements.", what does "delegate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: delegate /ˈdel.ɪ.ɡeɪt/ (động từ): giao phó, uỷ quyền. Cấu trúc "delegate X to Y"; danh từ "delegate" = người đại biểu.
items.explanationEn: delegate /ˈdel.ɪ.ɡeɪt/ (verb): to hand over to others. Pattern: "delegate X to Y"; as a noun, a delegate is a representative.

items.question: Trong câu "is self-defeating: a model is simpler than the system it models.", từ "self-defeating" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "is self-defeating: a model is simpler than the system it models.", what does "self-defeating" (adjective) mean?
options: tự mâu thuẫn, phản tác dụng
items.explanation: self-defeating /ˌself.dɪˈfiː.tɪŋ/ (tính từ): tự mâu thuẫn, phản tác dụng. Lập luận "self-defeating" tự làm hỏng chính mục đích của nó.
items.explanationEn: self-defeating /ˌself.dɪˈfiː.tɪŋ/ (adjective): working against its own aim. A self-defeating argument undermines its own purpose.

items.question: Trong câu "A decision table collapses 16 combinations to 5 distinct requirements using dashes for irrelevant conditions.", từ "collapse" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A decision table collapses 16 combinations to 5 distinct requirements using dashes for irrelevant conditions.", what does "collapse" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: collapse /kəˈlæps/ (động từ): rút gọn, thu gọn. "Collapse X to/into Y" = gộp nhiều thành ít; trong UI, "collapse a section" = thu gọn mục.
items.explanationEn: collapse /kəˈlæps/ (verb): to reduce to fewer. "Collapse X into Y" means reduce many to few; in UIs you "collapse" a section.

items.question: Trong câu "Event-response tables are essential for real-time systems where use cases fall short; the response depends on both the event and the state.", từ "fall short" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Event-response tables are essential for real-time systems where use cases fall short; the response depends on both the event and the state.", what does "fall short" (phrase) mean?
optionsEn: to drop to a low level
items.explanation: fall short /fɔːl ʃɔːt/ (cụm từ): không đáp ứng đủ. "Fall short of expectations" = không đạt kỳ vọng.
items.explanationEn: fall short /fɔːl ʃɔːt/ (phrase): to fail to be enough. "Fall short of expectations" means fail to meet them.

items.question: Trong câu "Models reveal errors that text conceals, because they show you the forest instead of individual trees.", từ "conceal" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Models reveal errors that text conceals, because they show you the forest instead of individual trees.", what does "conceal" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: conceal /kənˈsiːl/ (động từ): che giấu. Trái nghĩa với "reveal" trong cùng câu; trang trọng hơn "hide".
items.explanationEn: conceal /kənˈsiːl/ (verb): to hide. The opposite of "reveal" in the same sentence; more formal than "hide".

items.question: Trong câu "Models cross-check each other: compare DFDs with swimlanes, context diagrams with event lists, ERDs with the data dictionary.", từ "cross-check" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Models cross-check each other: compare DFDs with swimlanes, context diagrams with event lists, ERDs with the data dictionary.", what does "cross-check" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to strike out with a cross
items.explanation: cross-check /ˌkrɒsˈtʃek/ (động từ): đối chiếu kiểm tra chéo. "Cross-check the figures" = kiểm tra chéo số liệu bằng một nguồn khác.
items.explanationEn: cross-check /ˌkrɒsˈtʃek/ (verb): to verify against another source. "Cross-check the figures" means verify them against another source.
